title: Agent Descriptor
description: Public metadata an agent advertises for discovery and orchestration.

id.description: Stable, globally unique identifier. Reverse-DNS RECOMMENDED.

endpoint.description: Base URL for the HTTP transport binding. REQUIRED for the HTTP binding; omitted for stdio-only agents.

taskRetention.description: Minimum seconds a task remains retrievable via tasks/get after reaching a terminal state. After this window, tasks/get MAY return -32000 TaskNotFound.

configSchema.description: A JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) describing the configuration this agent component accepts at instantiation. Use `default` keywords for defaults so the agent runs with no config supplied. Agents MAY incorporate the well-known shapes from config.json (model/provider, systemPrompt, tools, resources, limits, SecretRef). Absent means the agent takes no configuration.
